after_cl.checkpoint_selection_note: Every treatment arm uses best.pt, selected on validation Recall@1. The control uses last.pt deliberately: its pairings are permuted, so validation Recall@1 is meaningless by construction and selection on it picked epoch 3 (R@1 0.00567, chance 0.00227) — an almost untrained checkpoint. last.pt matches the treatment on training steps, which is the comparison the control is for.
after_cl.name: attention-pooling 4-block baselines (matched control for the uniform arm)
after_cl.note: Identical to the runs of the same name in gold-probe-extended-v3; re-extracted here only so that both arms share one extraction pass, one fold assignment and one set of study resamples.

before_cl.name: dinov2-unadapted
before_cl.pooling: uniform mean over the three planes

uniform_pooling.name: uniform plane pooling, 4 blocks, three seeds
uniform_pooling.note: One lever against after_cl: --image-plane-pooling uniform. plane_attention_768 is absent by construction -- these towers have no attention parameters -- so only uniform_mean_768 and projection_256 exist. uniform_mean_768 is the primary metric and is identically defined for both arms, which is what makes the contrast valid.

arms_note: frozen_tower_null is deliberately absent: its identity assertion was made and passed under gold-probe-extended-v3 and it contributes nothing to the pooling contrast. Arms here are the unadapted backbone, the three attention-pooling baselines, and the three uniform-pooling runs.

bootstrap.limitation: resampling studies is not resampling patients; anonymisation is per study, so patient identity is unverifiable

cohort_note: The cohort manifest pinned here defines the study population and the preprocessed images only. The two arms were trained on two manifests whose images and splits are identical; they differ in report text, and the base multilingual manifest additionally retains two studies the translated manifest quarantines. The 56-study gold population resolves identically under both, verified before training.

comparisons.cohort_contrast: after_cl/original-multilingual-seed2026/uniform_mean_768 versus after_cl/translated-english-seed2026/uniform_mean_768, paired over the same studies, folds and study resamples, via scripts/compare_downstream_arms.py
comparisons.confounded: uniform pooling also removes the plane_embeddings and plane_attention parameters, so this arm tests pooling and a smaller head together and cannot decompose them. projection_256 is a learned 768->256 linear-plus-GELU compression; a linear probe cannot gain from compression, so this arm is reported but is not evidence against contrastive learning
comparisons.preregistered_criterion: All three seed deltas must share a sign and each seed's descriptive 95% interval must exclude zero. Fixed in digest/plane-pooling-protocol.md before the first run and not to be renegotiated.
comparisons.primary: after_cl (attention pooling) versus uniform_pooling, per seed, on uniform_mean_768 -- matched pooling at readout and identical dimensionality, so the only difference is how training pooled the planes. Also each against before_cl/uniform_mean_768.

estimand: Readout quality of a frozen representation on a cohort it was trained on. Explicitly NOT generalisation: 56 of 58 gold cases were exposed to contrastive training or checkpoint selection.

metrics.environment_note: sklearn 1.8 deprecates the explicit penalty=l2 argument pinned above and removes it in 1.10. The fitted model is unchanged, since l2 is the default; a rerun on 1.10 must translate it to l1_ratio=0 rather than silently dropping it.
metrics.primary: pooled out-of-fold AUROC per label, macro-averaged over the 12 labels
metrics.rare_labels: MCL has 8 positives over 56 cases: pooled-OOF only, fold-level AUROC declared uninformative in advance
metrics.tie_policy: midrank. Every reported point estimate comes from sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score. The bootstrap replicates use an equivalent rank-sum implementation (scipy.stats.rankdata) for speed, and the script asserts the two agree to 1e-9 on every label's real scores before building any interval. Section 6 of the EDA notebook's argsort AUROC is reported alongside the LM reference for comparison only, never used as a result.

population: gold studies whose cohort split is train or validation; locked-test gold studies are counted only

probe.fold: StratifiedKFold(shuffle=True), stratification computed inside the per-label fold loop
probe.predictions: exactly one held-out decision_function score per study per label
probe.standardize: StandardScaler fitted inside each training fold
probe.tuning: none; every hyperparameter is fixed here before the first fit

purpose: The pre-registered uniform-plane-pooling arm (digest/plane-pooling-protocol.md) scored against its three matched 4-block attention-pooling baselines in one extraction pass, so both arms share identical folds and resamples. Probe, metric, bootstrap, labels and cohort are copied unchanged from gold-probe-extended-v3; nothing is tuned.

reference.lm_label_extraction: data/lm_label/*.csv scored against the same gold labels on the same 56 studies, as the text-side label-extraction ceiling

scope: Read-only over existing artifacts. No training, no locked-test evaluation, no writes into any run directory.
